cohort: 35 infants with persistent wheezing (PW) and 28 age-matched infants (control group)
finding: Alterations in lower airway microbiota, specifically increased abundances of Elizabethkingia and Rothia, are strongly associated with the development of wheezing and may be associated with wheezing recurrence later in life.
mod_finding: Caesarean section demonstrated a greater impact in airway microbiota compositions.
